trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload on Android 14. This is currently the top Android crasher at ~4% of sessions. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Owner: Marcus. Deadline: fixed and verified by Wednesday (before August 20 release) so QA has time before release. Acceptance criteria: crash no longer reproduces on Android 14.

trello.name: Verify Android crash fix in regression run
trello.desc: Confirm Marcus's Android 14 photo upload crash fix on the Android 14 test devices and add it to the regression run. Owner: Sam. Deadline: after Marcus lands the fix, before the August 20 release. Acceptance criteria: fix confirmed on Android 14 test devices and included in regression suite.

trello.name: Build offline sync API for notes list
trello.desc: Build the backend sync API endpoint for the notes list offline mode promised to enterprise customers last quarter. The client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins; no merge UI in this pass. Owner: Elena. Deadline: have it in review before Elena is out on the 17th and 18th.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Implement the client side of offline mode for the notes list: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them when connectivity returns. Write the acceptance criteria into the ticket. Owner: Marcus. Acceptance criteria: user can open the app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when back online with no data loss.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Finish migrating CI pipelines to GitHub Actions, completing the test and release pipelines and keeping the nightly build schedule. Run both GitHub Actions and Jenkins systems in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off; keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean. Owner: Sam. A proof of concept for the build job already exists.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint, which was degraded by a misbehaving script last week. Limit: 100 requests per minute per user; return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that. Also add a metrics counter so we can see who is hitting the limit. Owner: Elena.

trello.name: Update consent screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Update the privacy policy/consent screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. Get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen; nothing should be pre-checked. Owner: Marcus. Deadline: must be in the August 20 release; this is a launch blocker for the EU launch.

trello.name: Write regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Write automated regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal: have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline. Owner: Sam. Acceptance criteria: tests running in CI within the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
